# cloudzero_monitor (Resource)

Manages a CloudZero anomaly monitor. Monitors created by CloudZero (system monitors) cannot be managed with Terraform.

CloudZero rejects a monitor whose filter matches no cost data, and a monitor whose detection settings (filter, grouping, cost type, and threshold) match an existing monitor. To manage an existing monitor, import it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudzero_monitor" "s3_by_account" {
  name        = "S3 spend by account"
  description = "Alerts the platform team when S3 spend in any account jumps."

  filter = {
    "services" = ["AmazonS3"]
  }
  group_by = ["accounts"]

  threshold {
    min_cost_impact = 100
    percentage      = 20
    operator        = "AND"
  }

  notifications {
    email            = ["platform-team@example.com"]
    slack_channel_id = "C0123ABCD9"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Monitor name, 1-255 characters.

### Optional

- `cost_type` (String) Cost type to monitor: REAL_COST, AMORTIZED_COST, BILLED_COST, CUSTOM_COST, DISCOUNTED_AMORTIZED_COST, DISCOUNTED_COST, INVOICED_AMORTIZED_COST, ON_DEMAND_COST. Defaults to REAL_COST.
- `description` (String) Monitor description, up to 1000 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the monitor runs. Defaults to true.
- `filter` (Map of List of String) Spend to watch. Map of dimension ID (e.g. "services", "accounts", or "costcontext:Team") to the values to match. Prefix a dimension ID with "!" to exclude its values, "&" for case-insensitive partial matching, or both. Omit to watch all spend.
- `group_by` (List of String) Dimension ID (e.g. "accounts") to group by, detecting anomalies per value of that dimension. At most one dimension.
- `notifications` (Block, Optional) Where incident notifications are sent. Omit to send none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--notifications))
- `threshold` (Block, Optional) Minimum impact for a detected anomaly to raise an incident. Omit to raise an incident for every anomaly. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--threshold))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of creation.
- `id` (String) Monitor identifier.
- `owner_id` (String) Who created the monitor. Monitors created with an API key show "Set via API".
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last update.

<a id="nestedblock--notifications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notifications`

Optional:

- `email` (Set of String) Email addresses to notify, in lowercase.
- `slack_channel_id` (String) Slack channel ID to notify (e.g. "C0123ABCD9"), not the channel name. The CloudZero Slack integration must be connected.


<a id="nestedblock--threshold"></a>
### Nested Schema for `threshold`

Optional:

- `min_cost_impact` (Number) Minimum daily spend above the expected range, in dollars.
- `operator` (String) How to combine min_cost_impact and percentage: AND or OR. Required when both are set, and not allowed otherwise.
- `percentage` (Number) Minimum daily spend above the expected range, as a percentage of its upper end.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cloudzero_monitor.s3_by_account 0d6f4f1e-5b3a-4c8e-9a2b-7e1c3d5f9a10
```
